project.name: Claude Code - ykdojo-Inspired Enhancements
project.description: Implement high-value patterns from ykdojo/claude-code-tips repository

stories.title: Add ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH to settings.json
stories.description: Enable lazy-loading of MCP tools to reduce context overhead. With multiple MCP servers (GitHub, Cloudflare, Playwright, Context7, Chrome), this saves ~10% context.
acceptance_criteria: Add ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: true to env section of settings.json
Verify Claude Code still loads and MCP tools work
Document the setting's purpose in a comment
stories.notes: Added ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: true to env section of settings.json

stories.title: Create /handoff Command
stories.description: Create a command for generating structured handoff documents for session continuity. Better than ad-hoc session management.
acceptance_criteria: Creates HANDOFF.md in project root with standard sections
Sections: Goal, Current Progress, What Worked, What Didn't, Next Steps
Updates existing HANDOFF.md if present
Command works in any project directory
stories.notes: Created handoff.md with structured template for Goal, Progress, What Worked/Didn't, Next Steps, Key Files

stories.title: Create /gha Command
stories.description: Create a command for debugging GitHub Actions failures systematically. Checks flakiness first, identifies breaking commit, then root cause.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts GitHub Actions URL as argument
Checks for flakiness (past 10-20 runs of same job)
Identifies potential breaking commit
Provides root cause analysis
Checks for existing fix PRs
stories.notes: Created gha.md with 5-step workflow: Get Info, Check Flakiness, Identify Breaking Commit, Root Cause, Check Existing Fixes

stories.title: Document ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH in cc-guide
stories.description: Add documentation for the ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable in the Claude Code guide's MCP section.
acceptance_criteria: Explain what ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH does
Show how to set it (env var or settings.json)
Explain when to use it (many MCP servers)
Add to appropriate section near auto:N docs
stories.notes: Added ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH env var documentation to MCP Tool Search section at line 1304

stories.title: Add Chrome Best Practices to corrections.md
stories.description: Add specific rules for Claude-in-Chrome usage: use refs not coordinates, avoid screenshots unless requested.
acceptance_criteria: Add Chrome MCP section to corrections.md
Document: use read_page for refs, click with ref not coordinates
Document: never screenshot unless explicitly requested
Keep rules concise
stories.notes: Added Chrome MCP section with 4 rules: use refs, no coordinates, no screenshots, avoid alerts

technical_notes.enable_tool_search: When true, MCP tools are lazy-loaded instead of injected upfront. Reduces context overhead ~10%.
technical_notes.handoff_pattern: Structured document for context continuity across sessions. More reliable than relying on session resume.
technical_notes.gha_workflow: Systematic debugging: flakiness check -> breaking commit -> root cause. Prevents chasing red herrings.
